reason: ACCT-AMORT-K-1 (PR #1290). Original-authorship deterministic amortization-schedule kernel, authored from scratch for this estate against ISDA 2006 Definitions §4.16 (day-count conventions) and the effective-interest method, per ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §1. No third-party source, package, or code was copied into it. Named `_amort.bundle.mjs` (not `_amort.mjs`) because ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §4.1 mandates the shipped `_detmath.bundle.mjs` shape verbatim for any shared, inline-consumed kernel bundle — the RISC0 guest provides only `_hash`, so a bundle import is unavailable in-guest and this filename convention is how the estate marks 'reuse vehicle, always inlined, never imported at runtime', independent of authorship.
